paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 3, end of halakhah 1, he speaks in Rabbi Hoshaya’s name. The Ran there reads Rabbi Simon bar Taddai, and this was also the reading of the above Jerusalem Talmud available to the author of Yuchasin HaShalem.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1 has Rabbi Simon detri reporting Rabbi Hoshaya. The Ran reading bar Taddai and the corresponding Yuchasin reading remain Hyman's reports, since those witnesses were not directly collated. No patronymic or identity is supplied from the similarity of the forms.
